title: Bridge Assets Into Soroban
description: A game contract rewards players in on-ledger USDC. The contract cannot use classic payment operations, so it needs the built-in contract that exposes an issued Stellar asset to Soroban.

content.prompt: What is the Stellar Asset Contract (SAC)?
options: A built-in Soroban contract that exposes an issued Stellar asset to smart contracts
A SEP that defines hosted anchor deposits
A Horizon endpoint that finds path payment routes
A governance contract used to upgrade anchors

solution: A built-in Soroban contract that exposes an issued Stellar asset to smart contracts
hint: Each Stellar asset has a reserved SAC instance. Once deployed, contracts can call standard token functions on it and the SAC reads and writes the same trustline balances used by classic Stellar. Documentation: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/tokens/stellar-asset-contract
author: StellarHunts Core

testCases.title: The SAC is the asset bridge
Path finding is a Horizon endpoint
The SAC is not a governance contract
